name: Beat me in a duel
ask: {name} looks you over. “Beat me in a fair fight, and I'll follow you anywhere.” {say.challenge}
done: {name} picks {their} way up off the ground, laughing.

name: Beat my rival
ask: “There's someone who has made my life a misery. Put them in the dirt, and I'm yours.” {say.angry}
done: {name} watched {target} go down, and could not stop grinning.

name: Save my village
ask: “Bandits come to my home every season and take what they like. Drive them off, and I'll come.” {say.sad}
done: {place} is free of them. {name} cannot thank you enough.

name: Pay off my debt
ask: “I owe more than I can ever pay. A loan shark owns me until it's paid.” {say.sad}
done: {name}'s debt is paid, and {name} is free to go.

name: Find my sister
ask: “My sister went to sea years ago and never wrote. Help me find her.” {say.sad}
tracker: Find {name}'s sister: last heard of in {place}
done: In {place} you found {name}'s sister, alive and well. {name} wept.

name: Earn my master's blessing
ask: “I won't leave without my master's blessing. Win {target} over, and I'll come.” {say.proud}
tracker: Win the respect of {target}, {name}'s master, in {place}
done: {target} gave {name} leave to go, and a blessing with it.

name: Take me somewhere
ask: “Take me to {place}. I'll work my passage, and we'll see after that.” {say.greet}
done: {name} stood on the deck at {place}, looked around, and stayed aboard.

name: Show me you are strong
ask: “I follow the strong. Come back when you're strong enough to protect me.” {say.doubt}
done: {name} felt the change in you before you said a word.

name: Make a name for yourself
ask: “Nobody has heard of you. Make them hear of you, and then ask me.” {say.tease}
done: {name} has heard of you now, like everyone else.

name: A real ship
ask: “I'm not sailing in a bathtub. Get a ship with a berth for me.” {say.tease}
tracker: Own a ship with a free berth
done: {name} walked the deck of your ship and nodded.

name: Offer me a Devil Fruit
ask: “They say a Devil Fruit makes you something more. Bring me one.” {say.challenge}
done: {name} turned the fruit over in {their} hands, swirls and all.

name: Bring me a sword worth carrying
ask: “I'll carry no dull blade into your service. Bring me a graded sword.” {say.proud}
tracker: Give {name} a graded sword or better
done: {name} drew the blade and tested its edge against the wind.

name: Prove you are honourable
ask: “I've heard what people say about pirates. Let me hear something better said of you.” {say.doubt}
tracker: Be spoken of as honourable in {place} (at least {amount})
done: {name} has heard what is said of you in {place}, and believes it.

name: The moment
ask: {name} shakes {their} head. “Not now. Maybe not ever.” But {their} eyes follow you out.
done: When {name} had nobody else, you were there. {they} asked to come with you.

name: Teach me
ask: “Teach me how you fight. Three months of lessons, and I'll know if you're worth following.” {say.challenge}
done: {name} has learned enough from you to want to learn the rest.

name: Break my friend out
ask: “My friend is rotting in a cell in {place}. Get them out, and I'm with you.” {say.angry}
tracker: Free {name}'s friend from the cells of {place}
done: {name}'s friend walked out of {place} a free person.

name: Pay up front
ask: “I don't work for promises. Pay me up front.” {say.tease}
done: {name} counted every coin, twice.

name: Give it time
ask: “I don't know you. Give it time, and we'll see.” {say.evasive}
done: {name} trusts you now. That was always the hard part.

name: A doctor for my sister
ask: “My sister is sick, and no doctor here can help. Bring one who can.” {say.sad}
tracker: Have a doctor in your crew, or pay {amount} Berries for medicine
done: {name}'s sister is getting better. {name} has never been so grateful.

name: Beat me at my own game
ask: “Beat me at what I'm best at, and I'll believe you can lead.” {say.challenge}
done: {name} stared at the result, then laughed out loud.
